$schema_note: Prompts for Google Gemini (Imagen / Nano Banana) to generate the remaining App Store assets for ClipShot. The icon and one Cursor-with-ClipShot marketing screenshot are already sourced in ../found/. Brand: navy-to-black diagonal gradient (top-left #3b82f6 -> middle #1e3a8a -> bottom-right #000000), white camera+clip glyph, single light blue (#60a5fa) accent dot. Aesthetic: modern Apple macOS Sonoma/Sequoia, San Francisco font, vibrancy/translucency, subtle drop shadows, generous whitespace, ultra-clean.
app_summary: ClipShot is a macOS menu-bar utility that automatically saves every screenshot you take, keeps a history of the last 30 captures (browsable from the menu bar), copies each new shot straight to the clipboard, and shows a small floating thumbnail in the bottom-right corner that you can click to open or drag-and-drop into any app. Tagline: 'Tu historial de screenshots, siempre listo en el portapapeles.' / 'Your screenshot history, always ready on your clipboard.'

missing_assets.intent: Primary App Store screenshot showing the ClipShot menu-bar dropdown open with its screenshot history grid
missing_assets.style_constraints: macOS Sequoia desktop with a subtle dark navy/blue abstract wallpaper that echoes the ClipShot brand gradient. Menu bar at top with the small white camera.viewfinder icon highlighted in the upper-right area. Dropdown menu open beneath the icon, using native NSMenu vibrancy (dark mode, translucent dark gray). Menu shows: header 'ClipShot — historial de screenshots', separator, then 6 rows each displaying a tiny 140x90 thumbnail of a different real-looking screenshot (a website, a chat app, a code editor, a photo, a Finder window, a maps view) with a Spanish date/time string like '23/5/26, 12:59:22'. Below: 'Abrir carpeta del historial', 'Limpiar historial', 'Preferencias ›', 'Acerca de ClipShot', 'Salir'. Crisp SF font, exact macOS spacing, no fake UI weirdness.
missing_assets.gemini_prompt: Ultra-realistic 2880x1800 macOS Sequoia desktop screenshot, dark mode, San Francisco font. Wallpaper is an abstract navy-blue to black diagonal gradient (#3b82f6 top-left, #1e3a8a middle, #000000 bottom-right) with very soft light streaks. At the top, the standard macOS menu bar with translucent dark vibrancy. In the upper-right area of the menu bar, a small white camera.viewfinder SF Symbol icon for an app called ClipShot. Open directly below that icon: a native macOS NSMenu dropdown (dark vibrancy, 8px rounded corners, soft shadow) about 360px wide. Top of the menu: disabled header text 'ClipShot — historial de screenshots' in light gray, then a thin separator. Below: six menu rows each showing a real-looking 140x90 rounded-corner thumbnail of a different screenshot subject (1: a colorful website with hero image, 2: a chat conversation in a messaging app, 3: a code editor with syntax highlighting, 4: a landscape photo, 5: a macOS Finder window, 6: an Apple Maps view), each followed by a Spanish timestamp such as '23/5/26, 12:59:22'. Below the thumbnails another separator and the items 'Abrir carpeta del historial', 'Limpiar historial', 'Preferencias ›' (with a small disclosure chevron), 'Acerca de ClipShot', and 'Salir'. Pixel-perfect macOS rendering, accurate row heights, native gray separators, no spelling errors, no extra ornamentation, no fake logos. Clean, polished, suitable for the Mac App Store.
missing_assets.negative_prompt: no Windows UI, no iOS UI, no fake/garbled text, no rounded outer corners on the full image (Apple wants flat rectangles), no watermarks, no people, no extra widgets in the menu bar that conflict with reality, no purple or warm-toned wallpapers

tool_suggestions: Google Gemini Imagen 3 / Nano Banana for the hero and preview frame (best for cinematic / typographic compositions).

For the three pixel-accurate UI screenshots (menu, floating thumbnail, preferences), prefer running ClipShot locally and screen-capturing — Gemini can be unreliable for native macOS UI fidelity. Use these prompts as fallback only.
post_processing: All final PNGs MUST be RGB, no alpha channel, exact pixel dimensions listed.
Verify no transparent pixels with: sips -g hasAlpha <file> (should report 'no').
App Store icon: must be flat square 1024x1024 — Apple applies the squircle mask. Already generated at found/appstore_icon_1024_appstore_ready.png.
